Frequently Asked Questions

Membership FAQ

Who can join the Society?

Faculty members, researchers, editors, students, librarians, professionals and other eligible applicants can be invited according to the society's membership rules.

Will members receive a certificate?

A membership certificate can be issued after verification and completion of the membership process.

Can students become members?

Yes, a dedicated student membership category can be offered with student-focused benefits.

Can I participate in academic events?

Members can be informed about eligible conferences, workshops, webinars and other society activities.

How will my information be used?

The live website should publish a privacy policy explaining collection, use, storage and protection of membership information.
